description: Cold launch: new user → WelcomeScreen → age modal (18+) → ComplianceGuard → HomeShell Talk tab

steps.note: Wait for splash to resolve to WelcomeScreen (no seen key set)
Welcome: breathing circles, headline, trust chips, Continue button
Age modal: headline, 'Not yet' / 'Yes, I am' buttons
Tap 'Yes, I am' → _confirmAdult() → writes has_seen_welcome_v1 → pushes ComplianceGuardScreen
Compliance check: GPS permission prompt + geocode + allowed check
